name: Spicy Mushroom & Tofu Soup
steps: Start by slicing the chestnut mushrooms and pak choi. Dice the tofu into small cubes and cut the spring onion into 2cm pieces.
Add the pack choi to a Tupperware along with the tofu, gochujang, spring onions, soy sauce, enoki mushrooms, chestnut mushrooms and mushroom stock. Box up and pop in the freezer until ready to use.
Once ready to cook, transfer the contents of the Tupperware into a saucepan set over a medium heat. Cover with a lid and allow the contents of the pan to melt.
Once melted, leave the soup to simmer for 5 minutes until the broth is piping hot. Then serve up topped with a scattering of sesame seeds and a drizzle of sesame oil.
